metadata.scope: Public rustia project readiness, based on the current workspace and canonical design docs.
notes: Percentages are rough engineering estimates, not automated metrics.
The scope tracks public rustia crates, conformance, benchmarks, docs, tooling, and release readiness.
The public host-bridge remains generic; grabby-specific types and effect catalogs stay outside public rustia.

benchmark_adapters.note: mlua-lua54 runs separately from mlua-luau because both mlua-sys builds use links = "lua".

overall_goals.name: Whole public rustia project
overall_goals.state: Design is locked and production crates are substantial, with crate metadata, examples, and CLI ergonomics started; release, CI, and perf gates remain.
overall_goals.future_plan: Harden P1, finish benchmark gates, then move toward full public Luau parity.

overall_goals.name: Usable embedded scripting crate
overall_goals.state: The rustia facade supports owned values, typed host functions, retained functions, serde, extensions, hot reload, and compile-checked examples.
overall_goals.future_plan: Stabilize API semantics, diagnostics, capability policy, and migration docs.

overall_goals.name: Full public Luau engine release
overall_goals.state: Luau 0.709 target and conformance corpus are strong; production engine still needs perf and parity hardening.
overall_goals.future_plan: Complete P1/P2 runtime work, then P4 parity items such as module/loading, typechecker/LSP track, and release packaging.

overall_goals.name: Standalone benchmark OSS project
overall_goals.state: Harness, package metadata, split notes, machine-readable inventory, current-results JSON, generated claim gate, history, static site, five default workload families, and all 10 requested adapters are present.
overall_goals.future_plan: Split from workspace, expand workloads, wire CI, and publish charts/history.

overall_goals.name: Public release readiness
overall_goals.state: License, crate metadata, explicit internal dependency versions, compile-checked examples, CLI ergonomics, release-readiness checklist, semver policy, changelog validation, release preflight, generated benchmark claim gating, package file-list audit, and publishability blocker audit are present; crates are still workspace-private and CI/release polish is incomplete.
overall_goals.future_plan: Remove publish blockers in topological order and replace the not-approved benchmark claim gate with credible per-workload public claims.

entries.name: Constraint and target model
entries.state: Core priorities, target matrix, and public/private boundary are documented.
entries.future_plan: Keep docs synced as implementation exposes new constraints.

entries.name: Architecture decisions
entries.state: All eight architecture axes are decided in design/30-architecture.md.
entries.future_plan: Reconfirm value-layout/dispatch on JSC and SpiderMonkey before final P1 lock.

entries.name: Review cleanup
entries.state: Third-party review findings are folded into canonical docs.
entries.future_plan: Treat new findings as incremental deltas, not a redesign.

entries.name: Current-state tracking
entries.state: design/CURRENT.md is authoritative and current for implementation state.
entries.future_plan: Keep README, progress data, and design docs aligned after each major implementation slice.

entries.name: Research spikes
entries.state: Dispatch, value layout, libm determinism, GC, snapshot, and wasm-JIT directions are backed by spikes.
entries.future_plan: Keep spike outputs as evidence, but move production claims to benchmark gates.

entries.name: Luau 0.709 pin
entries.state: Target version, standalone surface, vector width, flags posture, and f64-only behavior are documented.
entries.future_plan: Watch upstream FFlag::LuauIntegerType2 and update only with explicit evidence.

entries.name: Manifest and refs
entries.state: 684 fixtures and 481 refs are executable with 0 pending rows.
entries.future_plan: Add focused fixtures for newly found gaps instead of reopening bulk inventory.

entries.name: Upstream corpus execution
entries.state: Whole upstream Luau 0.709 conformance scripts are represented through executable fixtures.
entries.future_plan: Preserve green status while hardening engine internals.

entries.name: Harness and coverage notes
entries.state: Runner, manifest validation, and detailed coverage notes are in-tree.
entries.future_plan: Add coverage metadata for new public-parity features as they land.

entries.name: Lexer
entries.state: Production lexer crate exists with tests.
entries.future_plan: Expand edge-case coverage as conformance finds parser/lexer gaps.

entries.name: Parser
entries.state: Hand-written parser handles Luau syntax and type-grammar erasure.
entries.future_plan: Continue differential and conformance-driven hardening.

entries.name: Type grammar parse-and-erase
entries.state: Type syntax is parsed for runtime erasure; no typechecker is intended for P1.
entries.future_plan: Defer gradual typechecker/LSP work to public-parity phase.

entries.name: Compiler
entries.state: Production compiler emits bytecode and supports conformance-specific paths.
entries.future_plan: Harden constant folding, diagnostics, superinstructions, and optimization boundaries.

entries.name: Bytecode dispatch core
entries.state: Portable interpreter exists; big-match/br-table direction is locked.
entries.future_plan: Add hot/cold split, benchmark call_ref, and maintain fusion-invariant fuel.

entries.name: Value representation
entries.state: 16-byte tagged value direction is implemented and documented.
entries.future_plan: Keep representation sealed until JSC/SpiderMonkey measurements close the gate.

entries.name: Heap and GC
entries.state: gc-arena direction is chosen and production heap code exists.
entries.future_plan: Tune Standard pacing and DeterministicSim instruction-count collection intervals.

entries.name: Tables/metatables
entries.state: Broad table, metatable, iteration, and stdlib table behavior is conformance-covered.
entries.future_plan: Continue parity hardening and performance work.

entries.name: Functions/coroutines/pcall
entries.state: Functions, closures, varargs, coroutines, and protected calls have broad coverage.
entries.future_plan: Keep stackless recursion and yield paths covered as runtime changes.

entries.name: Base/math/string/bit32/vector/utf8 stdlib
entries.state: Major Luau stdlib surfaces are covered by fixtures.
entries.future_plan: Fill remaining public-parity libraries and edge cases.

entries.name: Error/debug behavior
entries.state: Debug/error behavior is substantially covered for conformance.
entries.future_plan: Tighten diagnostics and source-span reporting for public API use.

entries.name: f64/libm/canonicalization discipline
entries.state: Deterministic number policy is documented and partly enforced by tests.
entries.future_plan: Keep compiler and VM on the same libm/canonicalization rules.

entries.name: Runtime profiles
entries.state: LuauCompat, ReproducibleStandard, and DeterministicSim are defined; public APIs expose profiles.
entries.future_plan: Refine exact capability behavior and profile-specific GC policy.

entries.name: Fuel and limits
entries.state: Instruction fuel exists and is part of the design contract.
entries.future_plan: Version fuel costs and keep superinstructions fuel-invariant.

entries.name: Cross-engine wasm proof
entries.state: V8 evidence exists; JSC and SpiderMonkey are still open gates.
entries.future_plan: Build real wasm measurement harness and record golden results.

entries.name: Koto-shaped facade
entries.state: Builder, compile/run, globals, exports, retained functions, and examples exist.
entries.future_plan: Stabilize names, error types, and migration docs.

entries.name: Owned value firewall
entries.state: OwnedValue, owned tables/keys, and conversions exist.
entries.future_plan: Harden conversion coverage and avoid leaking internal GC lifetimes.

entries.name: Typed host functions
entries.state: Plain Rust functions can be registered with typed args/results.
entries.future_plan: Expand arity/signature support and improve diagnostics.

entries.name: Extension/linker layer
entries.state: Namespaced extensions and coarse capabilities exist.
entries.future_plan: Add richer capability metadata, fuel costs, and policy validation.

entries.name: Public host-bridge seam
entries.state: The generic seam for deterministic host functions, typed slots, and effect ordering is documented without public grabby types.
entries.future_plan: Keep public rustia generic while strengthening capability enforcement and scratch-heap rules.

entries.name: Serde bridge
entries.state: Owned-value serde paths exist.
entries.future_plan: Add zero-copy live-value deserialization after the public surface stabilizes.

entries.name: Retained handles
entries.state: Script function handles can be retained and called.
entries.future_plan: Define invalidation/versioning behavior around hot reload.

entries.name: Hot reload
entries.state: Compile/install/hot-reload entry points exist, with an example covering retained handles across reload failure.
entries.future_plan: Guarantee old-program survival, diagnostics, and handle semantics with stronger tests and docs.

entries.name: Macro/codegen sugar
entries.state: Macro sugar exists as an early slice, but the lower-level API should lead.
entries.future_plan: Delay expansion until the core API stops moving.

entries.name: Harness CLI and schema
entries.state: bench/ has a standalone-style CLI, package metadata, machine-readable inventory, validated JSONL history schema, refreshable RESULTS.md, current-results JSON, and generated per-workload claim gating.
entries.future_plan: Keep JSONL as the source of truth for CI and website data.

entries.name: Adapter matrix
entries.state: All 10 requested adapters are implemented; mlua-lua54 runs as a separate binary from Luau because of mlua-sys linking constraints.
entries.future_plan: Split adapters into standalone crates/binaries and keep baselines current.

entries.name: Workloads
entries.state: Five default workload families are wired, with 11 Luau workload seeds and partial cross-engine coverage present.
entries.future_plan: Expand toward the 11-15 workload plan including interop, serde, fuel, and string building.

entries.name: History and static site
entries.state: Append-only history, dirty-baseline guards, markdown results, current-results JSON, dependency-free dashboard files, and claim-gate markdown are present.
entries.future_plan: Publish long-run history and richer charts after standalone split.

entries.name: Benchmark CI
entries.state: CI workflow wiring is not present.
entries.future_plan: Add self-hosted [self-hosted, bench] workflows after runner setup is confirmed.

entries.name: Wasm-emit JIT spike
entries.state: Runtime wasm emission is validated in spikes, not production-integrated.
entries.future_plan: Add type guards/deopt and interpreter-equivalence checks before production use.

entries.name: Native/wasm matrix
entries.state: Native baselines are being recorded; full wasm engine matrix is deferred.
entries.future_plan: Measure V8, SpiderMonkey, and JSC on production rustia wasm.

entries.name: Workspace tests and release preflight
entries.state: Production crates have meaningful unit and conformance tests, and just release-preflight composes release artifact checks with cargo test --workspace.
entries.future_plan: Keep expanding tests with new runtime/API work and add CI wiring when runner setup is available.

entries.name: CLI
entries.state: rustia-cli supports file, stdin, and --eval execution with profile, fuel, and source-name options, plus unit-tested parsing.
entries.future_plan: Add richer diagnostic formatting and REPL ergonomics.

entries.name: Live wasm demo
entries.state: demos/live-wasm can build and serve a browser demo outside normal workspace gates.
entries.future_plan: Refresh after production wasm/perf work and make it a public example.

entries.name: Crate publishability
entries.state: Workspace crates are still publish = false, but public metadata, explicit internal dependency versions, leaf package checks, package file-list audit, publishability blocker audit, release checklist, semver policy, changelog validation, and release preflight are present.
entries.future_plan: Flip policy only after P1 gates, then publish/remove internal dependency blockers in generated order.
